boundary: Stage 27M is bounded larger-sample robustness evidence for calibrated eraser-cover intervention over Pythia-160M CPL2 likelihood margins. It is not complete circuit discovery, not weight editing, not model-wide control, not cross-model control, and not visible free-form generation control.

random_control_match_profile.policy: Random controls use same layer/kind replacements when available. For singleton MLP blocks, the fallback preserves kind across candidate layers; if that is impossible, the report marks an unmatched fallback.
